questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that traffic is merging from the right. Slow down and make space for merging traffic.

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down at a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. Stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or roadway.

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign tells you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Watch for people walking.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to curves ahead. Reduce your speed and be ready for the winding road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of multiple curves coming up on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride beside the road. Drive carefully in this area because cyclists may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross ahead. Be careful and watch for people crossing the road.

Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or go straight. You cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to road hazards. This sign warns of a steep downhill slope ahead. Slow down to prevent brake failure or accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a steep hill coming up. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead.

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. When weather or road conditions are poor, slow down.

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).
